graphEvents.label: Which commit rules collide with a numbered identifier?
SUBJECT_RE grammar: 13 types, kebab scope, numeric-only scope blocked
TRAILER_RE is a closed 8-key/3-verb whitelist; new keys count as body
commit-msg is active machine-wide via global core.hooksPath

label: SUBJECT_RE at commit-msg:72 requires one of 13 types, lowercase kebab scope, optional !, non-empty summary
Numeric-only scope is a hard block; packet-path scopes are deliberately rejected
Summary hard blocks: lowercase start, no repeated spaces, no trailing punctuation, no vague phrases; process labels warn only
Subject >100 chars blocks; documented target is 80
TRAILER_RE is a closed whitelist (Co-Authored-By, Signed-off-by, Reviewed-by, Tested-by, Refs, Fixes, Closes, Related to); Claude-Session and new keys are not recognized
>=4 staged paths require an explanatory body line; a non-whitelisted machine trailer currently satisfies that gate
The hook is installed machine-wide via global core.hooksPath pointing at the main clone's hook sources
No prepare-commit-msg hook and no commit-msg unit test exist
Refs: <issue, PR, or spec path> is the only documented commit-to-packet link and it is optional, unvalidated, and ambiguous
Doc contract forbids numeric scopes and process metadata in subjects; process metadata belongs in body or Refs
NEVER rule 10 prohibits amending pushed/merged commits; the retrofit needs the operator's explicit exception
